Definition: Jishmael, the name of Abraham's oldest son, and of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ishmael = "God will hear"; 1) son of Abraham and Sarah's handmaid Hagar and the progenitor of the Arabian peoples; 2) son of Nethaniah and the murderer of Gedaliah; 3) a Benjamite, one of the sons of Azel a descendant of Saul through Meribbaal or Mephibosheth; 4) a Judaite, father of Zebadiah; 5) a Judaite, son of Johanan and one of the captains who aided Jehoiada in restoring Joash to the throne; 6) a priest of the family of Pashur with a foreign wife whom he was forced to put away by Ezra
